text:
I am currently on maternity leave with my first baby have just launched to the app store my first app!

I'm a product designer by trade and learnt to vibe code on Claude about a month ago now. I was weaning my baby and he developed a rash and haven't been able to work out what the pattern was causing it. So I created an app for weaning parents to log the food, add any reactions so when talking to their GP they can start to see a pattern and all advice, like nutrients, food variety, how to serve food all coming from the NHS and FSA.

Currently got 12 mums using the app and would love any feedback to make it even better! <3

https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/niblet-weaning-diary/id6822680...

https://getniblet.app
